title: A pathway to toxic extracellular vesicle secretion
title_zh: 有毒细胞外囊泡分泌的通路
abstract: The ion channel P2RX7 drives the transition of microglia to an inflammatory state in a mouse model of tauopathy and contributes to pathogenic extracellular vesicle-mediated tau propagation.
abstract_zh: 离子通道 P2RX7 在 Tau 病变小鼠模型中驱动小胶质细胞向炎症状态转变，并促进致病性细胞外囊泡介导的 Tau 传播。
snippet: The ion channel P2RX7 drives the transition of microglia to an inflammatory state in a mouse model of tauopathy and contributes to pathogenic extracellular vesicle-mediated tau propagation.
